name: Gelatinous Cube

traits.name: Ooze Cube
traits.desc: The cube fills its space; other creatures can enter it but are then engulfed. Inside, they take 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns.

traits.name: Transparent
traits.desc: While motionless, a DC 15 Perception check is needed to notice the cube.

actions.name: Engulf
actions.desc: The cube moves up to its Speed; creatures in its path make a DC 12 Dexterity save or are engulfed (Restrained, 10 (3d6) Acid damage).

desc: A clear block of jelly that keeps dungeon corridors spotless — and full of undigested gear.
treasure: Coins, weapons and other indigestible items floating inside.
